# Suwenzo: Complete System & Operational Facts

> Suwenzo is clinic software for Sri Lanka that connects the doctor's desk, patient records and dispensary in one system, with WhatsApp reminders so patients return on time.

Based in Colombo, Sri Lanka, Suwenzo is built specifically for the outpatient workflow of local private medical practices.

---

## 1. Fast Facts & System Specifications

- **Software Name:** Suwenzo
- **Website:** https://www.suwenzo.com
- **Headquarters:** Colombo, Sri Lanka
- **Target Audience:** Solo general practitioners, private clinics with an attached dispensary, consulting-only practices, and multi-doctor group clinics.
- **Hardware Requirements:**
  - Doctor's desk: Any modern tablet (iPad, Android tablet) or laptop/PC with a modern web browser.
  - Dispensary counter: Standard laptop, PC, or tablet paired with a compatible thermal label printer for medicine envelopes.
- **Connectivity:** Web-based platform requiring an active internet connection (Fiber, 4G Wi-Fi router, or mobile hotspot). If connection drops, users switch to a mobile phone hotspot. No offline mode is currently supported.
- **Consultation Scope:** Exclusively designed for in-person outpatient clinic consultations. Online consultations are not available today.
- **Setup & Onboarding:** Most clinics are ready within 48 hours of the demo. Setup includes pre-loading the clinic's standard drug formulary and configuring label printer settings.
- **Pricing & Commercial Terms:** Pricing is shared during the demo. The first 10 founding clinics in Colombo get 3 months free.
- **Patient Follow-Up Reminders:** Scheduled and sent via WhatsApp. Explicit patient consent is required during registration.

---

## 2. Frequently Asked Questions (20 Questions & Answers)

### Setup & Onboarding

#### Q1: How long does clinic setup take?
Most clinics are ready within 48 hours of the demo. The Suwenzo team configures your clinic account, pre-loads your standard drug formulary, sets up your label printer, and trains your doctor and dispensary staff.

#### Q2: What hardware do we need to run Suwenzo?
Doctors typically use a tablet (such as an iPad or Android tablet) or a desktop/laptop in the consultation room. The dispensary requires a laptop, desktop, or tablet connected to a compatible thermal label printer.

#### Q3: Does Suwenzo support switching from paper files?
Yes. You do not need to scan years of old paper files. Most clinics begin recording consultations digitally for current visits while keeping physical folders as secondary archive reference.

#### Q4: How is the demo conducted?
Demos take approximately 20 minutes. We demonstrate the doctor consultation flow on a tablet, show live prescription transfer to the dispensary screen, and print sample medicine envelope labels. For Colombo clinics, demos can be held in person; online demos are available across Sri Lanka.

### Dispensary & Prescriptions

#### Q5: How do prescriptions reach the dispensary?
When the doctor saves a prescription, prescriptions appear on the dispensary screen within seconds. Dispensary staff immediately see the patient's name, age, prescribed medications, dosages, and instructions ready for packing.

#### Q6: How does label printing work at the dispensary?
Dispensers click once to print clear adhesive labels for medicine envelopes. The label prints the patient name, drug name, dosage instructions (e.g., 1 tablet twice daily after meals), and dates, eliminating illegible pen handwriting.

#### Q7: Does the system track stock and batch expiry?
Yes. Each time a prescription is packed, pill quantities decrement automatically from inventory. The system highlights low-stock medications and warns staff about approaching batch expiry dates.

#### Q8: Is it suitable for clinics without an attached dispensary?
Yes. Consulting-only practices can disable dispensary modules and use Suwenzo as a dedicated consultation workstation, generating clean printed prescription slips for external pharmacies.

### Connectivity & Technology

#### Q9: Does Suwenzo work offline if the internet drops?
No offline mode is currently supported. Suwenzo operates as a web-based clinical platform. If your broadband connection experiences an outage, we recommend connecting via a mobile phone hotspot.

#### Q10: Are online consultations available through Suwenzo?
Not today. Suwenzo is exclusively built for physical, in-person outpatient medical consultations at private clinics.

#### Q11: Can multiple doctors use the system in the same clinic?
Yes. Multi-doctor clinics can configure separate doctor profiles. Patient visit records remain accessible across practice doctors so continuity of care is maintained regardless of which doctor is on duty.

#### Q12: Can doctors use an iPad or tablet to prescribe?
Yes. The interface is optimized for touch screens and tablets, allowing doctors to select medications and dosages with minimal typing.

### Patient Reminders & Care

#### Q13: How do WhatsApp follow-up reminders work?
When a doctor selects a review interval (e.g., return in 5 days or 1 month), the system queues an automated WhatsApp reminder sent to the patient ahead of their review date.

#### Q14: Is patient consent required for WhatsApp reminders?
Yes. Patient consent must be obtained and recorded during registration before follow-up reminders are dispatched to their mobile number.

#### Q15: What channel is used for patient reminders?
Reminders are sent exclusively via WhatsApp, which is the communication channel patients in Sri Lanka open and read reliably.

#### Q16: How do allergy warnings work during consultations?
Documented drug allergies (such as penicillin or NSAID sensitivities) remain pinned prominently in red at the top of the patient's consultation view on every visit.

### Support & Commercial Terms

#### Q17: How much does Suwenzo cost?
Pricing is shared during the demo. The first 10 founding clinics in Colombo get 3 months free.

#### Q18: What is included in the founding clinic offer?
The first 10 founding clinics in Colombo receive 3 months of complimentary software access, complete hands-on onboarding, formulary loading, and priority support.

#### Q19: How do clinics get ongoing support?
Clinics receive direct WhatsApp support from the Suwenzo team for rapid troubleshooting during consultation and dispensary hours.

#### Q20: Where is Suwenzo based?
Suwenzo is based in Colombo, Sri Lanka. Our team conducts on-site onboarding in Colombo and the Western Province, with remote setup assistance across Sri Lanka.
